title: Hotel Revenue Manager
summary: Sets a hotel's room prices and decides which channels sell its rooms, so the hotel earns the most from each night. Sits in the commercial team with sales and reservations and reports to the general manager or a cluster revenue director.
dailyDuties: Review pickup and set daily room rates and restrictions
Load rates and inventory on OTAs through the channel manager
Check rate parity and competitor rates
Update the rooms forecast and budget tracking
Read the weekly STR report against the competitive set
Review RMS price recommendations in IDeaS or Duetto
Lead the weekly revenue meeting with sales and front office

skills.expectation: Set daily room rates and restrictions to grow occupancy, ADR and RevPAR
Manage rates and inventory across OTAs, the channel manager and GDS, and keep rate parity
Use an RMS such as IDeaS or Duetto and review its pricing decisions
Build rooms forecasts from pickup, pace and on-the-books data
Read STR and rate-shopping reports to track the hotel against its competitive set
Build revenue reports and models in Excel
Pull reservation and revenue data from the PMS
Run revenue meetings with sales, front office and the general manager
Understand how reservations and group blocks are loaded
Explain budget versus actual revenue variances
Present revenue strategy to owners and leadership
Build revenue dashboards in Power BI
